standard_prerequisites.name: Tensor-restrict adjunction for presheaves of modules: Hom_{O_1}(G, F_{O_1}) = Hom_{O_2}(O_2 tensor_{p,O_1} G, F)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the presheaf-level adjunction the sheaf statement descends from.

core_obligations: Start from the presheaf-level adjunction Hom_{O_1}(G, F_{O_1}) = Hom_{O_2}(O_2 tensor_{p,O_1} G, F) (proof lines 2150-2152). The sheaf tensor product O_2 tensor_{O_1} G is the sheafification of the presheaf tensor product O_2 tensor_{p,O_1} G, and since F is a sheaf, maps from either into F agree: Hom_{O_2}(O_2 tensor_{O_1} G, F) = Hom_{O_2}(O_2 tensor_{p,O_1} G, F) (proof lines 2153-2162). Combining with the presheaf adjunction yields the asserted canonical bijection, i.e. restriction and change of rings are adjoint for sheaves of modules (proof lines 2148-2162).
proof_roadmap: Invoke the presheaf-level tensor-restrict adjunction (proof lines 2150-2152).
Identify maps from the sheaf and presheaf tensor products into the sheaf F (proof lines 2153-2162).
